# A2: bounded local optimization of the six original parameters (generated by `npm run d1-refinement -- a2-local`)

Box (integer grid): X 20.0%–25.0%, Y 0.2%–0.8%, stop 6.5%–9.0%, hold 6–16, L 60–104, buffer 1.5%–4.0%. Design: scrambled Sobol, 4096 points plus the anchor, per anchor (seed from 'd1-refinement|sobol|a2-<anchor>'), evaluated on the full run and on the four training windows (through 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023). Selection policies: maxNet = highest net among feasible candidates (minute DD ≤ $35,000); balanced = highest net with minute DD ≤ $20,000 (D1's drawdown band), else maxNet; lowDd = lowest minute DD among candidates with net ≥ 80% of maxNet's; frequent = highest net among candidates with at least 1.5 × the reference entry count, else none. Feasibility: minute DD ≤ $35,000 and at least one entry per training year. Coordinate-wise refinement (every grid value of one parameter at a time, inside the box, until no move improves) from each full-run pick, in-sample.
